independent-events.def: Two events are independent when knowing that one happened does not change the probability of the other: $P(A \mid B) = P(A)$. For independent events, $P(A \cap B) = P(A) \cdot P(B)$. Events that are not independent are dependent.

union.def: The union of A and B, written $A \cup B$, is the event that A or B or both happen. The general addition rule gives its probability: $P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B)$.

venn.def: A Venn diagram draws the sample space as a rectangle and events as circles inside it. Overlapping circles show outcomes in both events; the regions can hold counts or probabilities.
